tools.name: supplier_portal_get_vendor_catalog_item
tools.description: Retrieve supplier-listed catalog item data (VendorPartNo, InternalMaterialXref, Price, MOQ, LeadTimeDays) for a material, across one or more vendors, for vendor comparison and ranking.

tools.name: supplier_portal_get_alternative_parts
tools.description: Retrieve alternative/substitute part cross-references (OriginalMaterial, AlternativeMaterial, CompatibilityNotes) for a given material, used to validate embedding-matched substitute candidates.

tools.name: supplier_portal_get_vendor_performance
tools.description: Retrieve vendor performance metrics (OTIFRate, RejectionRate, RatingScore) for one or more vendors.

tools.name: supplier_portal_submit_rfq
tools.description: Submit a request for quote (RFQ) to one or more vendors for a spare part. This is the connector's write action for sourcing; it only solicits pricing and never commits spend or issues a purchase order — any resulting order still flows through the SAP MM purchase requisition/PO approval chain. The resulting quote is ingested asynchronously.
